image_description: A single roll of white toilet paper mounted on a metallic wall-mounted holder. The end of the paper is folded into a decorative triangle shape, revealing a quilted or embossed texture on the surface. The background is a plain, light-colored wall.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Soft, thin, absorbent paper wound into cylindrical roll around cardboard tube.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is clearly a cylindrical roll of paper. While the cardboard tube is not directly visible through the center due to the angle and fullness of the roll, the overall geometry matches a standard toilet paper roll perfectly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Roll is compact with modest diameter and width, suitable for standard bathroom holder.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The proportions relative to the holder arm appear standard for household toilet paper.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Individual sheets perforated for easy tearing.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While perforations are typical, they are not clearly resolvable in this image resolution, especially on the folded section. Marking as untestable rather than absent to avoid false negative on subtle features.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Slightly textured, embossed surface pattern (quilted or dotted).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct diamond/quilted embossing pattern is clearly visible on the folded triangular flap of the paper.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cardboard core visible at center of roll.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The view is from the side/front; the hollow center (core) is occluded by the paper layers and the mounting hardware. It is impossible to see the core directly.
The paper is uniformly white/off-white, consistent with the class definition.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Matte, fibrous texture with visible paper fibers at close range.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The surface appears matte and non-reflective, consistent with paper fiber texture.
Similar to the first checkpoint, specific perforation holes are not distinctly visible at this resolution.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Household paper product in roll format.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is unmistakably a household paper roll.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific class identity and rule out similar cylindrical objects.
To detect subtle AI artifacts like smearing, unnatural softness, or edge bleeding common in generated textures.
To ensure the roll is a coherent solid object and not merging incorrectly with the holder or background.
To verify the physical plausibility of the holder's attachment to the wall and the depth of the roll.

focus_areas: Texture consistency of the embossed pattern
Edge sharpness between the paper roll and the metal holder
Physical plausibility of the folded paper triangle
Lighting and shadow consistency on the wall
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the embossed texture on the folded paper. AI generators often struggle with consistent micro-textures on deformed surfaces. Check if the pattern distorts naturally with the fold or if it looks pasted on. Also, inspect the connection point between the metal holder and the wall for any 'melting' or lack of clear mechanical structure.
